fields.description: Nonzero save-exists flag at start of EEPROM image; the only nonzero byte in 0x00..0xAF.
fields.evidence: Logical-domain byte 0x00 = 0x01 in samples/baseline.sav (rev8 logical domain, verified by readable footer ASCII at 0xB8). No EEPROM 0x0D00xxxx save routine exists in this 109-function decomp slice (save-io scan: single false positive FUN_08030bdc, an arithmetic helper); ROM-side buffer primitives in-slice are FUN_08030cfc (fill, used by init paths FUN_08009f5c/FUN_0801209c/FUN_08013490/FUN_08015bc8) and FUN_08030c9c (copy).
